model: AI segment of SpaceX: Grok and X advertising plus compute sold in whole-site blocks under Cloud Services Agreements from its own gas-powered Colossus sites in Memphis and Southaven. Revenue = nameplate GW online x utilization x price per watt (management frame $30-50 per watt per year); contracts mostly terminable on 90 days' notice. Funded by the group balance sheet: $100B cash after the June 2026 IPO, BBB bonds at 5.855%, a $40B Apollo-led chip package sought in October. Watch: GW online vs the 2 GW and 10 GW targets, AI infrastructure revenue vs depreciation, 90-day exits, power permits.
